named_question: Can the already supported add-mood creation operation expose its proposed record and count without mutation while preserving its existing allocation, defaults, admission and save behavior?

existing_source_basis.relationship: Existing automatic identity source and bounded CLI policy, including separate legacy explicit overrides and atomic exhaustion. No new role or identity admission.
Existing fixed18 construction, first-direct-scene reader bound and inherited type-nibble defaults, selected raw Q1 replacement and direct-record recount. No source rule changes.

Reuse existing raw color parser unchanged and preview output/early-return/dispatch conventions only. Its historical AddMood rejection describes the earlier delivery; all prior artifact bytes remain immutable.

canonical_sources.relationship: Existing selected dialog append caller passes the collection and automatic identity request.
Existing width18 append, first-scene high-nibble defaults, actual-vector recount and separate automatic SID/CID allocation.
Existing constructor sets the requested output width and initializes identity members.
Existing per-scene output reader bound and XML SID/CID binding, not a container-width or physical-channel inference.
Existing later reader width normalization does not re-read skipped higher stored Qn.

source_verification: All11 unique canonical hashes inherited from existing identity source_bindings and native_style_mood_initialization source_basis, frozen decompile-index hash and both prior committed Git-blob artifact hashes verified locally. Relevant existing canonical bindings reused without extraction or pin changes. No vendor text or private project data included.

CLI_policy.operation: lox config add-mood FILE SELECTOR --name NAME --color SPEC [--sid SID] [--cid CID] --dry-run [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.shared_plan: Immutable preview_mood_creation and existing add_mood API share one private typed LightingMoodCreationPlan containing the exact ordered attribute vector, typed SID/CID, collection path and count. The public proposed_mood map projects that vector; normal application uses that same vector/identity/count, retaining original attribute insertion order. No cloned DOM, writer-then-discard, generic framework or public UUID override/reapply API.
CLI_policy.ordered_admission: Existing read/XML load precede unchanged parse_color_to_mood. Existing list_moods resolution/type guard and recursive duplicate exact Name check precede repeated controller resolution and exactly-one-direct-collection check. Automatic/legacy ID allocation and existing explicit duplicate SID check precede native_mood_output_defaults and UUID generation. Same errors and ordering. No new Unicode/name/UUID/role/tag/capability/mode/count admission or repair.
CLI_policy.identities: Neither override: direct-record lowest-free SID1..99, single CID=SID+11 candidate for SID<=8 else0, preserving current needed signed32 checks and atomic exhaustion. Either override: existing recursive max-custom-plus-one/baseSID2/baseCID9 partner policy, reserved1/776/777/778 exclusions, checked i64 successor and duplicate SID behavior. Explicit duplicate CID and supported signed/role values remain accepted, not swapped/normalized. Existing duplicate UUIDs remain untouched; existing UUID generation is unchanged.
CLI_policy.defaults: Exactly one existing direct LightscenesC is required; container_created is false, not a promise to synthesize missing storage. Proposed attributes are precisely Name, generated UUID, Outputs18, SID, CID and Q1..Q18, with no IID/options/default insertion. Q1 remains parsed raw value; Q2..Q18 use the existing first-direct-scene signed32 high nibble within its reader bound. Missing/zero source Outputs means12; supported sparse/outside-bound values remain unneeded. Existing raw container Outputs is not used as scene width. Num becomes direct scene count plus1 regardless of prior Num spelling/value; nested scenes do not count.
CLI_policy.output: scope stored_mood_creation; stored controller_uuid/controller_title; controller-relative collection_path XML child-node indices; container_created; optional raw before_num and decimal after_num; proposed_mood contains every actual proposed LightsceneC attribute, including identity and outputs. No invented decoded/effective/UI/physical-channel field. JSON adds dry_run and optional trace_id; CSV carries presence fields and quoted strings; table quotes raw strings. Quiet hides only table summary, no-header only headers. Normal writer report/API remains unchanged.
CLI_policy.RNG_limit: Planning allocates an ephemeral UUID in memory. Separate preview and execution invocations may generate fresh UUIDs. Execution never promises to reuse a preview UUID. A same-private-plan/application unit proof checks exact UUID and every proposed attribute without requiring deterministic RNG across requests.
CLI_policy.preservation: Preview returns before editor mutation, save, serialization, Document stamping or destination handling on success and failure. No source/destination/default/directory/cache/telemetry writes; no destination writability or write-success prediction. Input/existing/new missing-parent save-as paths are untouched. Existing writer API tuple, JSON/table report, UUID generation, overwrite/save/stamp behavior and every unrelated record/attribute/order/width/count/sequence/reference/unknown field retain their current semantics.
CLI_policy.dispatch: Only existing ConfigCmd::AddMood is newly admitted to global dry-run. Other unplanned local/live/deployment mutations remain rejected before dispatch and startup side effects.

native_validation.limits: Read-only preview of an already supported creation operation only. No new native observation/approval, family/whole-file/SPS/runtime credit, GUI Cancel/dialog refresh, graph-dependent preparation, native role/default/import normalization, color-picker semantics or final-save/write-success prediction. Original native cases, frozen CLI and prior artifact bytes remain untouched.
